training_torch_rng: exact inherited3470 torchRng after all model/Adam initialization
selection: At common512 choose highest strict prose success over old24+new9; then lowest repeat count; then lowest aggregate teacher DEV NLL; ties A,B,C order. All-zero success permits exactly ONE full admitted-data pass as undertraining diagnosis, not capability success. DEV selection bias explicit.
success: old strict gate unchanged; exploratory improvement requires>=4/24 strict old prose, >=2 more than inherited initial, and harmful repeats<=initial0; new9 separate and necessary qualitative check. EOS or NLL alone insufficient.
continuation_gate: finite losses/gradients, exact resume, no safety/data failure, valid storage; all-zero comparison can proceed to ONE corpus pass; no repeated epoch; if later NLL improves but repetition increases relative previous milestone, record regression and do not extend beyond fixed pass
stop: nonfinite, ambiguous optimizer intent, mismatched source SHA, resume discrepancy, free disk below600MiB; save or preserve last atomic state; no fabricated count
response_gate: Only if strict natural prose materially improves without repeated/irrelevant replacement; else no response phase
revision: v3 source-ID-resolved family exclusion before continuation; original comparison unchanged
